outcome: Blood glucose levels (Fasting blood glucose, 2h postprandial blood glucose, blood glucose before bed)
Immune function (IgG, IgM, CD3+, CD4+, CD8+, lgA levels)
Maternal outcomes (Amniotic fluid index, weight at delivery, body mass index, weight gain during pregnancy, incidence of negative pregnancy outcomes)
cohort: The study included 96 patients with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) admitted to a hospital between March 2018 and January 2020, with 48 patients randomly assigned to each of two groups.
finding: Targeted care plus exercise intervention significantly improved blood glucose control, enhanced immunological function, reduced the risk of negative pregnancy outcomes, and increased patient satisfaction in GDM patients compared to routine care.
